label: 백금 대검 기사 · 서 있는 대기 자세 시안
scope: Single full-body standing-pose resource candidate requested by the user; no animation sequence or runtime registration.

checked: Closed ivory horned helmet, antique-gold plate, pale hair, dark/ivory cloth and ornate greatsword match the design reference.
Adult body proportions retained; knee, lower leg and armored boots fully visible.
Pommel, grip, guard and blade form a straight continuous sword axis.
Hand grips the handle; both arms and boots are complete.
Character silhouette and sword tip do not touch canvas edges.
Background alpha ranges from 0 to 255; no UI, carousel controls, text or scenic backdrop.
